name: Shortcuts Bridge
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
The cursor and replace outputs add the text at the end of a note that is not open.
Adds the Pro output replace-line, which puts the output of a shortcut in place of the cursor line.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
The cursor and replace outputs now add text at the end of a note that is not open, instead of opening it.
Pro has a new replace-line output that puts the result of a shortcut in place of the cursor line.
tip: The selection input sends the current line when nothing is selected.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Shortcuts Bridge is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for keeping it in your editor.
